standard.coverage: Employers covered by Puerto Rico's Minimum Wage Act (Act 47-2021); FLSA-covered employers must in any case pay at least the higher of this and the federal $7.25.
standard.note: $10.50 is the third and last legislated step of Act 47-2021 ($8.50 from 2022-01-01, $9.50 from 2023-07-01, $10.50 from 2024-07-01). Further increases come from Puerto Rico's Minimum Wage Review Board rather than automatically.

tipped.note: DOL's tipped table carries Puerto Rico at the federal $2.13 cash wage with a tip credit large enough to reach $10.50.

knownGaps: Act 47-2021's own sectoral exclusions (agriculture, and the separate treatment of employees covered by a federal wage order) are not modelled.
